english.title: Use a vehicle on a road when the front fog lamp(s) were used and visibility not seriously reduced / vehicle parked
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) used on a road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), on which a front fog lamp was used so as to

(A)_[be lit when visibility was not seriously reduced]_
(B)_[be lit when the vehicle was parked]_
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 27 of the Road Vehicles Lighting Regulations 1989, section 42 of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level three on the standard scale (level four if goods vehicle or vehicle adapted to carry more than eight passengers).

Fixed penalty ticket - Fifty pounds.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
